prompt: You left the cafe. The mailbox is still signed in somewhere else.

choices.label: The sign-in left with the network.
The work network was the one you joined.

prompt: Two names: the cafe you were told, and the same name with a small change.

choices.label: Use only the name you were given.
The open one is the guest one.

prompt: The lock spinner fails. The laptop is offline.

choices.label: A failed lock still locked it.
Call it in. The lock did not land.
Wait until it is online again.

prompt: It checked in from a network that is not the cafe. You had not called.

choices.label: A check-in means it is safe.
Someone else had it, and nobody knew.
Buy a new one and move on.

prompt: They told you not to call back, then confirmed by text from that same number.

choices.label: Two channels mean it is them.
It is still the one number.
A meeting is why you skip the call.

prompt: You watched from the doorway. The history has two new sites.

choices.label: Watching is the same as locking it.
